name: Pyrovalerone
summary: Pyrovalerone (Centroton, 4-Methyl-β-keto-prolintane, Thymergix, O-2371) is a central nervous system (CNS) stimulant that acts as a norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (NDRI).

pharmacology.text: Pyrovalerone (Centroton, 4-Methyl-β-keto-prolintane, Thymergix, O-2371) is a central nervous system (CNS) stimulant that acts as a norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (NDRI).

uses.text: It was developed in the 1980s and had briefly been approved in Spain and France for chronic fatigue or lethargy and as an appetite suppressant, but was withdrawn from both markets around 2001 due to safety concerns including problems with abuse and dependence.

sideEffects.text: Side effects of pyrovalerone include decreased appetite, anxiety, fragmented sleep or insomnia, and trembling, shaking, or muscle tremors.

summaryZh: 吡咯戊酮是一種精神活性藥物，通過作為去甲腎上腺素-多巴胺再吸收抑制劑發揮興奮作用，用於臨床治療慢性疲勞或嗜睡以及作為減肥目的的厭食或食慾抑制劑。它於1960年代末研發，此後在法國和其他幾個歐洲國家使用，儘管吡咯戊酮仍偶爾被開出處方，但由於濫用和依賴性問題而很少使用。
